name: その動画、車内で勝手にプレミア上映していませんか(再制作版・最新仕様)

p_d6877194f9.sentence: If staff have reasonable grounds to suspect someone of breaking a rule, authorized staff can ask them to leave.
p_d6877194f9.prev: The government also explained in October 2026 that passengers who do not stop the sound when staff ask them to may be made to get off at the next station.
p_d6877194f9.next: If they refuse, staff can also remove them using no more force than is needed.

p_d2fae3700c.sentence: And we have no say in the song choice.
p_d2fae3700c.prev: It may be a song that lifts the person’s mood, but to everyone around them it is “train music no one asked for.”
p_d2fae3700c.next: In response to this clash of sounds, Britain’s railways have started a campaign asking people to use headphones.

p_0f9794d130.sentence: But one casual song could lead to a cost that is anything but casual.
p_0f9794d130.prev: This does not mean you will automatically get a £1,000 fine as soon as you make a sound.
p_0f9794d130.next: The government also explained in October 2026 that passengers who do not stop the sound when staff ask them to may be made to get off at the next station.

p_9adf8546f2.sentence: Don’t make the person next to you take on the job of telling you off.
p_9adf8546f2.next: Keep your enjoyment in your own ears.

p_14cb0d5f73.sentence: You just got on a train, but suddenly you are forced to attend a “solo concert” by the person next to you.
p_14cb0d5f73.prev: We Share the Train Car, but We Don’t Have to Share Our Playlists
p_14cb0d5f73.next: You don’t remember buying a ticket.

p_6080fc6b37.sentence: You didn’t ask for an encore.
p_6080fc6b37.prev: You don’t remember buying a ticket.
p_6080fc6b37.next: But the next song starts anyway.

p_0d126e8649.sentence: It is an effort by the government and the rail industry, and many railway companies will spread the message through posters, online notices, and announcements on trains and at stations.
p_0d126e8649.prev: In response to this clash of sounds, Britain’s railways have started a campaign asking people to use headphones.
p_0d126e8649.next: This announcement does not mean that a new railway rule has been made.

p_f3a3924183.sentence: And it may not end with just a request.
p_f3a3924183.next: According to the Department for Transport, if you are found guilty of breaking a rule, such as making noise that bothers others, you could face a fine of up to £1,000.

p_210c04c598.sentence: The point is to keep your music to yourself, so fellow passengers don’t have to ask you to stop.
p_210c04c598.prev: Britain’s railways are urging passengers to use headphones, while existing rules ban sounds that bother others without the railway’s written permission.

p_aabe5020d3.sentence: Existing railway rules in the UK ban singing or playing sounds from a device in a way that bothers other people, unless the railway company has given written permission.
p_aabe5020d3.prev: This announcement does not mean that a new railway rule has been made.
p_aabe5020d3.next: The problem is not “forgetting your headphones.”
